answer: Here weight is earned, never bought: a key gains standing only from quorum-matched grading verdicts it has sealed on-ledger, one per epoch of honest judgment. A fresh identity sits on a bare terrace with no nectar of peer-checked history to offer; trust opens slowly, like a violet, and cannot be pre-stacked. To field M clones an attacker must repay M times the grading labor across epochs - no warmed credential is transferable - so the Sybil bill grows linearly in identities while reward per seat stays flat.
